title: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
snippet: In 400B-token pretraining, U-MoLT outperforms OLMo3 across 700M/1.5B dense and 3B MoE models, achieving 1.7x validation cross-entropy (CE) token efficiency at 700M while improving 3B MoE 10-domain perplexity by 0.75 and 10-task accuracy by 2.1 percentage points.

title: Global electricity generation more than doubled from 2000 to 2025
snippet: Coal was the largest global source of electricity generation from 2000 to 2024, increasing 83% from 5.8 trillion kWh to 10.5 trillion kWh. However, the share of the world’s total generation from coal decreased from its peak of 41% in 2007 to 33% in 2025.
